fixes.label: Anchor and Raise Embarcadero Seawall
fixes.rationale: Jet-grouting liquefiable bay mud beneath the historic rock dike prevents lateral spreading during the M7.0 quake, while a raised parapet blocks the 4.15m king tide plus tsunami run-up.

sources.title: Port of San Francisco Waterfront Resilience Program

fixes.label: Tie Down Foundations on Liquefiable Fill
fixes.rationale: Installing micropiles, grade beams, and ground-improvement columns prevents differential settlement and shear failure in the 889 low- and mid-rise buildings sitting on historic bay fill.
fixes.group_label: Low- and Mid-Rise Buildings on Liquefaction Fill (889 buildings)

sources.title: California Geological Survey Seismic Hazard Zones

fixes.label: Brace Unreinforced Perimeters and Diaphragms
fixes.rationale: Adding steel moment frames, parapet bracing, and plywood shear walls prevents first-story collapse and out-of-plane wall failure across the largest cluster of waterfront structures.

sources.title: SF Department of Building Inspection Soft Story Program

fixes.label: Harden Substations, Fuel Lines, and Fire Pumps
fixes.rationale: Base-isolating substation transformers, fitting flexible seismic shutoff valves on fuel tanks, and adding independent diesel generators to AWSS fire pumps breaks the post-earthquake fire ignition and suppression failure chain.
fixes.group_label: Power, Fuel Handling & High-Pressure Fire Water Nodes

fixes.label: Stabilize Ferry Berths, Bridge Ramps, and Comms
fixes.rationale: Reinforcing ferry terminal batter piles, restraining bridge approach hinge joints, and hardening telecom battery backups preserves emergency evacuation corridors and maritime staging after shaking subsides.
fixes.group_label: Ferry Terminal, Bridge Approach, Evac Roads & Comms

archetypes.rationale: A 25-second M7.0 duration triggers cyclic pore-pressure buildup in Embarcadero bay mud, causing foundation bearing loss at lower PGA thresholds than standard ground-shaking curves assume.
Mid-rise structures on fill experience amplified spectral accelerations alongside lateral ground deformation, lowering median collapse capacities and increasing dispersion.
